sep01-planning.summary: Planned the checkout revamp rollout with Dev, meeting in the middle on pacing, and blocked out reconciling work for the mismatches bothering finance. Feels like a good, busy month ahead.
takeaways: Planned the checkout revamp rollout with Dev, settling on staggered steps.
Blocked out this week's recon work for the finance mismatches.

sep03-recon-cutoff.summary: Spent the day tracing the ledger mismatches you'd been living with, found the cutoff bug, and got the dry run down from 340 to 12. Frustrated at first, feeling good by the end.
takeaways: Traced 340 nightly mismatches to a UTC/Pacific cutoff bug.
Pushed a fix to staging; dry run dropped to 12 mismatches.
Planning to look at the 12 remaining mismatches tomorrow.
sep03-recon-cutoff.impact_note: Dry run mismatches dropped from 340 to 12.

sep08-pairing-leo.summary: Paired with Leo on his first ledger PR, where he wrote the test first on his own, and reviewed checkout code in the morning. A good day.
takeaways: Paired with Leo on his first ledger PR; he wrote the test first on his own.
Reviewed code for the checkout team in the morning.

sep09-recon-clean.summary: The recon job ran clean all week, and the cutoff refunds turned out to be the cause of the 12 mismatches. Hannah confirmed finance will stop the manual month-end sheet, saving them 2 days each close.
takeaways: Recon job ran clean 7 nights in a row with zero mismatches.
Fixed the 12 mismatches, refunds issued across the cutoff.
Hannah said finance will drop the manual month-end spreadsheet.
sep09-recon-clean.impact_note: Finance drops manual month-end spreadsheet, saving ~2 days per close.

sep10-interviews.summary: Interviewed two backend candidates and wrote detailed feedback for both. The first was strong on system design but weak on payments; the second likely won't proceed.
takeaways: Interviewed two backend candidates, wrote detailed feedback for both.
First was strong on system design, weak on payments.
Second is likely a no, couldn't explain their own project.

sep14-quiet.summary: A quiet day: read the processor's webhook docs and made notes, reviewed three PRs, and cleaned up ledger logging. Nice to have a day without meetings.
takeaways: Read the processor's webhook migration docs and made notes.
Reviewed three PRs, including one of Leo's.
Cleaned up logging in the ledger service.

sep16-people.summary: A people-heavy day: three one-on-ones, an ownership agreement on payment retry logic, and a backend hire. Exhausting but useful work.
takeaways: Ran three one-on-ones, including Leo's first on-call page handled solo.
Agreed your team owns payment client retry logic until the new client ships.
Interview debrief ended in a hire for the backend role.

sep17-five-percent.summary: Rolled Checkout Revamp out to 5% after testing the config and kill switch with Priya. Dashboards look clean so far, cautiously happy.
takeaways: Checkout Revamp went to 5% traffic.
Priya helped double-check the flag config and kill switch.
Conversion matches the old flow, no new errors; 25% next week if quiet.
sep17-five-percent.impact_note: Checkout Revamp launched to 5% with conversion matching the old flow.

sep18-dashboard-p95.summary: Profiled the slow merchant dashboard transactions page, added a missing index and made the refund fetch lazy, cutting p95 from 1.8s to 600ms in production. Dev called it huge for merchant NPS.
takeaways: Profiled the slow transactions page, found a missing composite index and a wasteful refund fetch.
Cut transactions page p95 from 1.8s to 600ms in production.
Dev praised the fix as huge for merchant NPS.

sep21-double-charge.summary: Your change caused 41 double charges when the idempotency key regenerated on retry. Rollback and refunds were done same day, but you feel sick about it; Priya stayed late to help review the retry path.
takeaways: Took checkout to 50% and hit double charges from your idempotency-key bug.
41 customers double-charged; rolled back in 20 minutes and issued all refunds.
Priya stayed late to walk the retry path with you.

sep22-fix-and-meeting.summary: Fixed the retry bug with Priya's help and felt it was nailed down, but a defensive moment in a product meeting about pausing the rollout left you drained.
takeaways: Wrote the retry-bug fix and a test simulating the processor timeout.
Priya caught a retry-after-session-refresh case; fixed it together.
Agreed to return to 50% rollout Thursday if the postmortem goes okay.

sep23-postmortem.summary: The postmortem went well and produced three action items. You own the timeout test, already done, and spent the rest of the day on reviews, feeling lighter than Monday.
takeaways: Ran a blameless postmortem, came out with three action items.
Own the timeout test in the standard checkout suite, already done.
Caught up on reviews the rest of the day.

sep24-checkout-100.summary: Checkout Revamp went to 100% after a clean retry watch, and Grace called out the retry fix. Relieved the six-month effort is fully out.
takeaways: Rolled Checkout Revamp to 100% after a clean retry watch.
Grace called out the retry fix in the launch channel.
Relieved the six-month revamp is fully out.
sep24-checkout-100.impact_note: conversion up a bit on the new flow

sep25-short.summary: Fixed the flaky timezone test in the ledger suite, then called the week done.
takeaways: Fixed the flaky timezone test in the ledger suite.

takeaways: Finished the diagrams for the event-sourced ledger design doc.
Worried Marcus will challenge the slow balance-rebuild replay.
